items.title: Invite people and set their roles
items.detail: In Members, invite the Operations and Care lead, the finance reviewer, the product maintainer and the fleet specialist as members, and the stakeholder as a viewer. Give your trusted technical admin the organization administrator role in Keycloak.

items.title: Name the delegated approvers
items.detail: In Governance > Approval rules, add the Operations/Care Lead to 'Refunds up to AED 250', the person you delegate quotes to on 'Standard quotes up to AED 5,000' and the Finance Reviewer to step 1 of 'Commitments above AED 5,000'. Until then owners approve them.
items.summary: 0 of 3 delegated rules name a person.

details.note: Not here yet: apply the plan as an organization administrator.

items.title: Turn on two-step sign-in for everyone
items.detail: Two-step sign-in is switched on in the sign-in service (Keycloak). This plan cannot do it for you.
items.summary: Two-step sign-in is set in the sign-in service (Keycloak), which ANUM cannot read. Turn it on there for every account.

items.title: Turn on the two-person rule
items.detail: Go to Approval policy and turn on the two-person rule once you have a second owner.
items.summary: Off, and this workspace has 2 owners. Turn it on in Approval policy.

items.title: Configure the AI model
items.detail: In Settings > AI model, choose the provider and model and test the connection. Every agent needs it.
items.summary: No AI model is set up yet. Choose one in Settings > AI model and test it.

items.title: Connect integrations in the plan's order
items.detail: Connect them in this order: AI model, email and phone alerts, one mailbox per business, calendar, WhatsApp, online store, Zoom or Teams, tyre planning, speech, web search, marketing and social media, webhooks. Each one needs your own account and login.

items.title: Test and turn on each automation
items.detail: Every automation starts turned off. Run it by hand, check the result, then turn on its schedule or trigger.

items.title: Choose routine WhatsApp templates
items.detail: In WhatsApp > Templates, choose which templates may send without asking. Test each one first.

items.title: Give agents more freedom one step at a time
items.detail: Agents start with little freedom. Give an agent more in its Settings only after its drafts have been checked.
items.summary: A step you take yourself; ANUM has nothing to read for it.

items.title: Check backups
items.detail: On the server, run infra/oracle/backup.sh backup and enter the off-site backup key. The checklist reads the last run's result.
items.summary: No backup run is recorded on this server. Run infra/oracle/backup.sh backup there.
